# `fintech_txn_amount_below_single_limit`

> Single movements above 10,000 require manual approval and never arrive in this feed.

| | |
|---|---|
| Domain | [fintech](README.md) |
| Layer | **silver** — evaluated by the `silver` gate |
| Model | `slv_fintech__transactions` (`fintech_silver.slv_fintech__transactions`) |
| Column | `amount` |
| Check | `value_between` |
| Severity | `error` — a violation **stops the pipeline** |
| Defined in | [dbt/models/fintech/silver/_silver.yml](../../../dbt/models/fintech/silver/_silver.yml) |

## What it checks

`amount` is at most 10000.

## When it fails

The `silver` task of `medallion_fintech` fails, gold and `publish_gold` don't run, and the batch is never added to `fintech_gold`: consumers keep the batches published before. `quality_report` marks the run as blocked and sends the alert, if one is configured.

The rows that broke the rule in its latest evaluation are kept in `dq_audit.fintech_txn_amount_below_single_limit`.

## Tested by

Scenario **`amount_above_single_limit`**: a single transaction of 25,000 (limit is 10,000).

```bash
make generate DOMAIN=fintech SCENARIO=amount_above_single_limit BATCH=2026-10-20_amount_above_single_limit
make pipeline DOMAIN=fintech BATCH=2026-10-20_amount_above_single_limit
```
